quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ

parent_channels.name: Sky, Night, and Cyclical Time

subchannels.name: Sky Canopy and Exposed Overhead
subchannels.scene_or_process: An upper expanse arches over an outspread lower surface, while exposed things remain uncovered beneath it.
subchannels.active_motifs: sky `س م و:B004/m01`; earth `ء ر ض:B001/m01`; exposure to the open sky `ع ذ ب:B004/m01`; outer surface `ظ ه ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The opening sky and stretched earth form a vertical enclosure whose latent counterpart is the condition of standing openly beneath an uncovered surface.

subchannels.name: Cloud Gathering and Atmospheric Layers
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clouds accumulate, ride over one another, and become a covering made of stacked strata.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloud mass `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; stacking `ر ك ب:B002/m01`; superposed layers `ط ب ق:B002/m01`; covering `ك ف ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Atmospheric accumulation concretizes the surah's movement through successive layers as a gathered, covering mass.

subchannels.name: Twilight and Enclosing Night
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fading light gives way to darkness that covers and gathers what moves within it.
subchannels.active_motifs: twilight `ش ف ق:B002/m01`; night `ل ي ل:B001/m01`; dark covering `ك ف ر:B002/m01`; gathered load `و س ق:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Twilight marks the threshold, while night performs the enclosing and gathering action stated on the surface.

subchannels.name: Moon, Hidden Crescent, and Stellar Marker
subchannels.scene_or_process: A celestial body passes from concealment to fullness while nearby stellar signs mark the nocturnal field.
subchannels.active_motifs: moon `ق م ر:B001/m01`; hidden moon `س ر ر:B004/m01`; star `ق ل ب:B010/m01`; fullness and alignment `و س ق:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The full moon is one phase in a larger visibility cycle that includes concealment, stellar orientation, and completed alignment.

subchannels.name: Calendar, Cycle, and Measured Interval
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recurring celestial and bodily periods define bounded portions of time and transitions between them.
subchannels.active_motifs: recurring period `ق ر ء:B002/m01`; portion of an hour `ط ب ق:B010/m01`; evening interval `ل ي ل:B003/m01`; extended duration `م د د:B004/m01`; elapsed time `خ ل و:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The visible succession of night and moon opens onto a lexical network of cycles, elapsed spans, and measured time portions.

subchannels.name: Night Practice, Wakefulness, and Delayed Rest
subchannels.scene_or_process: Night becomes a behavioral interval for sustained activity, wakefulness, delayed eating, or neglected supervision.
subchannels.active_motifs: nocturnal practice `ل ي ل:B002/m01`; insomnia `ق م ر:B009/m01`; late supper `ق م ر:B010/m01`; unattended herd at night `ق م ر:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The temporal field is not merely astronomical; it governs human routines and the risks of wakefulness or unattended livestock.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The world is ordered through enclosure, layering, gathering, illumination, and recurring intervals.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the sky splits (84:1), twilight recedes (84:16), night gathers (84:17), the moon fills (84:18), and one layer succeeds another (84:19).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cloud masses, a hidden moon, a stellar marker, insomnia, late supper, and unattended animals all extend the same temporal enclosure.

parent_channels.name: Terrain, Water, and Cultivation

subchannels.name: Fertile Ground and Plant Establishment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Prepared soil becomes fit for growth, receives seed, and supports rooted vegetation.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile land `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; fitness for good growth `ء ر ض:B003/m01`; cultivated plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; seed-covering farmer `ك ف ر:B008/m01`; plant species `ص ل ي:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The stretched earth becomes an agrarian receiving surface whose value lies in fitness, covering seed, and sustaining growth.

subchannels.name: Depressions, Wells, and Unstable Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ground opens into pits or wells and can shift through tremor or subsidence.
subchannels.active_motifs: pit or soft depression `ث ب ر:B001/m01`; well `ق ل ب:B007/m01`; ground tremor `ء ر ض:B008/m01`; opening and ebb `ث ب ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Emptying and spreading land has a complementary recessed form in pits, wells, openings, and unstable earth.

subchannels.name: Irrigation Channels and Raised Field Edges
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is directed through canals bordered by raised ridges into productive ground.
subchannels.active_motifs: canal `ء ت ي:B004/m01`; canal bank or raised field `ر ك ب:B009/m01`; flowing water extension `م د د:B003/m01`; abundant water source `ع ل م:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The land's extension is operationalized as an irrigation system whose channels, banks, and water supply regulate yield.

subchannels.name: Flood, Stored Water, and Sweet Supply
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water arrives in force, gathers in quantity, and becomes a drinkable or sustaining reserve.
subchannels.active_motifs: imported floodwater `ء ت ي:B005/m01`; water supply `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; sweet water `ع ذ ب:B001/m01`; abundance `ق م ر:B008/m01`; extended water `م د د:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Arrival, extension, and abundance converge on water as both overwhelming influx and sustaining provision.

subchannels.name: Palm Growth, Fruit Core, and Crop Yield
subchannels.scene_or_process: A palm produces offshoots and fruit whose core, husk, first signs, and final yield form a cultivation sequence.
subchannels.active_motifs: agricultural yield `ء ت ي:B007/m01`; palm core `ق ل ب:B003/m01`; palm offshoot `ر ك ب:B007/m01`; husk `ك ف ر:B010/m01`; first fruit signs `ب ش ر:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same root network that presents arrival and covering also describes the staged emergence, protection, and harvest of palm produce.

subchannels.name: Frost Damage and Spoiled Dates
subchannels.scene_or_process: Exposure to cold or moonlit conditions damages dates and their containers, interrupting ripening and storage.
subchannels.active_motifs: frost-spoiled dates `ق م ر:B004/m01`; moon-damaged waterskin `ق م ر:B006/m01`; reddening fruit `ق ل ب:B015/m01`; direct exposure `ب ش ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Lunar visibility has an agrarian underside in vulnerable fruit and storage materials altered by nocturnal exposure.

subchannels.name: Sand Clefts, Mounds, and Sediment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Loose terrain divides into sandy clefts, accumulates in mounds, and records deposited traces.
subchannels.active_motifs: sandy cleft `ش ق ق:B007/m01`; sand mound `س ر ر:B015/m01`; deposited blood-like trace `ب ص ر:B004/m01`; receding opening `ث ب ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Splitting, concealment, and trace-bearing surfaces describe a terrain shaped by separation and deposition.

subchannels.name: Wild Growth, Truffle, and Aromatic Plants
subchannels.scene_or_process: Uncultivated or specialty growth yields edible crusts and aromatic woods or plants.
subchannels.active_motifs: truffle crust `س ر ر:B013/m01`; camphor `ك ف ر:B011/m01`; aloes plant `ء ل ي:B005/m01`; cultivated plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The terrestrial inventory extends beyond staple crops to concealed edible growth and valued aromatic vegetation.

subchannels.name: Hive, Colony, and Productive Habitat
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hollow dwelling supports an organized colony whose members work within a bounded habitat.
subchannels.active_motifs: hive `خ ل و:B012/m01`; plant support `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; work crew `ع م ل:B006/m01`; inhabited place `ك و ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Emptiness becomes productive enclosure when a hollow is inhabited by a coordinated working colony.

subchannels.name: Mown Grass and Herd Fodder
subchannels.scene_or_process: Grass is cut, gathered, and reserved to feed managed livestock.
subchannels.active_motifs: cut grass `خ ل و:B013/m01`; cutting fragment `ش ق ق:B006/m01`; herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; gathered livestock `و س ق:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Cultivated terrain supports husbandry through the intermediate process of cutting and storing fodder.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Land receives, channels, stores, and yields material life through soil, water, plants, and changing terrain.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the earth is spread and empties what it contains (84:3-4), while latent branches specify fertile soil, irrigation, floodwater, crops, and landforms.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Canal banks, wells, truffles, frost-damaged dates, camphor, aloes, sand clefts, and bee habitat emerge from the terrestrial field.

parent_channels.name: Perception, Knowledge, and Disclosure

subchannels.name: Sight and Insight
subchannels.scene_or_process: The eye receives a visible scene and converts it into discerning awareness.
subchannels.active_motifs: eyesight `ب ص ر:B001/m01`; insight `ب ص ر:B002/m01`; knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`; visible manifestation `ظ ه ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Surface seeing is linked to the epistemic movement from outward appearance to inward comprehension.

subchannels.name: Pupil, Sclera, and Directed Gaze
subchannels.scene_or_process: Contrasting eye structures focus vision while posture can lower or impair the gaze.
subchannels.active_motifs: pupil `ء ن س:B005/m01`; contrasting eye white and dark `ح و ر:B001/m01`; lowered gaze `س ج د:B005/m01`; snow blindness `ق م ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Visual perception is grounded in a precise bodily apparatus vulnerable to both disciplined lowering and environmental impairment.

subchannels.name: Hearing, Acceptance, and Receptive Attention
subchannels.scene_or_process: A message enters through hearing, is noticed, and is either accepted or met with withdrawal.
subchannels.active_motifs: hearing and acceptance `ء ذ ن:B002/m01`; perception and noticing `ء ن س:B002/m01`; unprotected exposure `خ ل و:B016/m01`; lowered attention `س ج د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The sky and earth's obedience to hearing contrasts with human vulnerability and the possibility of withholding receptive attention.

subchannels.name: Heart, Memory, and Internal Storage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Experience is gathered into an inward container where words and events are retained.
subchannels.active_motifs: heart `ق ل ب:B001/m01`; internal memory `و ع ي:B001/m01`; memorization `ظ ه ر:B019/m01`; studied recitation `ق ر ء:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The surah's language of inward awareness expands into a model of the heart as a vessel for memorized recitation and experience.

subchannels.name: Deliberation, Turning, and Analysis
subchannels.scene_or_process: A matter is turned over, divided, and examined before a deliberate course is chosen.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning and analysis `ق ل ب:B004/m01`; deliberate action `ظ ه ر:B018/m01`; deliberative division `ق س م:B006/m01`; critical alteration `ك د ح:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Physical turning and division become a cognitive procedure for testing alternatives and exposing defects.

subchannels.name: Certainty, Truth, and Verification
subchannels.scene_or_process: A proposition is established as real through knowledge, verification, and settled conviction.
subchannels.active_motifs: truth and reality `ح ق ق:B001/m01`; establishing truth `ح ق ق:B005/m01`; certainty `ظ ن ن:B001/m01`; knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The surah's fulfilled obedience and divine knowledge support a latent chain from supposition to verified reality.

subchannels.name: Probability, Doubt, and Uncertain Outcome
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person estimates an outcome without full security, moving among likelihood, doubt, and unreliable expectation.
subchannels.active_motifs: probability `ح س ب:B002/m01`; doubt `ظ ن ن:B003/m01`; unreliable outcome `ظ ن ن:B006/m01`; safety and reliability `ء م ن:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reckoning can remain speculative until tested against the security of a reliable conclusion.

subchannels.name: Accusation, Mistrust, and Disproof
subchannels.scene_or_process: Suspicion hardens into accusation, while counterevidence challenges a disputed claim.
subchannels.active_motifs: accusation `ظ ن ن:B004/m01`; mistrust `ظ ن ن:B005/m01`; attribution of falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; disputed truth `ح ق ق:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Epistemic uncertainty becomes socially consequential when it produces mistrust, accusation, and adversarial verification.

subchannels.name: Concealment, Discovery, and Manifestation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hidden matter is retained out of view, then uncovered and made visible.
subchannels.active_motifs: secret `س ر ر:B001/m01`; concealment `و ر ي:B005/m01`; discovery `ظ ه ر:B008/m01`; visible manifestation `ظ ه ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: What is inwardly concealed remains part of a disclosure process culminating in visible appearance or discovery.

subchannels.name: Expertise and Penetrating Discernment
subchannels.scene_or_process: An expert reads beneath the surface and reaches the operative core of a difficult matter.
subchannels.active_motifs: expert knower `س ر ر:B014/m01`; scholar `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; effective penetration `ء ت ي:B013/m01`; insight `ب ص ر:B002/m01`; inner essence `ق ل ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Deep understanding is figured as movement through an outer layer into an essence accessible to trained discernment.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sensory reception becomes inward retention, analysis, certainty, doubt, concealment, or discovery.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the surah names perception, knowledge, inward retention, supposition, and divine seeing at 84:6, 84:14-15, and 84:23.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Eye anatomy, lowered gaze, memorization, expert diagnosis, accusation, and deliberate reversal inhabit one epistemic field.

parent_channels.name: Speech, Signs, and Textual Transmission

subchannels.name: Call, Announcement, and Proclamation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker projects a summons or public announcement toward an audience.
subchannels.active_motifs: call `د ع و:B001/m01`; proclamation `ء ذ ن:B003/m01`; sign or banner `ع ل م:B002/m01`; naming aloud `س م و:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The desperate call on the surface belongs to a broader communicative spectrum from private invocation to formal proclamation.

subchannels.name: Dialogue, Reply, and Precise Discourse
subchannels.scene_or_process: Interlocutors exchange turns and refine a claim through exact verbal formulation.
subchannels.active_motifs: dialogue `ح و ر:B006/m01`; learned words `ل ق ي:B011/m01`; precise discourse `ح ق ق:B010/m02`; articulated speech `ب ل ل:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Returning speech becomes a disciplined exchange in which wording, articulation, and truth conditions are jointly negotiated.

subchannels.name: Greeting, Tidings, and Responsive Formula
subchannels.scene_or_process: A conventional utterance opens contact and delivers news that changes the recipient's state.
subchannels.active_motifs: formulaic greeting `ق ر ء:B006/m01`; glad tidings `ب ش ر:B005/m01`; joy `س ر ر:B010/m01`; affirmative response `ب ل ي:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Greeting, announcement, emotional reception, and reply form a complete interpersonal transmission scene.

subchannels.name: Recitation, Study, and Learned Wording
subchannels.scene_or_process: A text is gathered into ordered wording, read aloud, studied, and transmitted to a learner.
subchannels.active_motifs: reading `ق ر ء:B001/m01`; gathered wording and study `ق ر ء:B001/m02`; learned words `ل ق ي:B011/m01`; knowledge `ع ل م:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Recitation is simultaneously vocal performance, textual gathering, study, and the reception of learned language.

subchannels.name: Writing, Joining, and Ink
subchannels.scene_or_process: Separate marks or materials are joined into durable writing through inscription and ink.
subchannels.active_motifs: writing `ك ت ب:B002/m01`; joined construction `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; ink `م د د:B005/m01`; retained content `و ع ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The written record arises from joining marks with ink and preserving the resulting content for later retrieval.

subchannels.name: Naming, Appellation, and Reputation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A name identifies a person or place and can expand into a publicly circulating reputation.
subchannels.active_motifs: naming `س م و:B005/m01`; reputation `س م و:B008/m01`; good name `ص ل ح:B004/m01`; proper name or place-name `ي س ر:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Naming begins as reference but becomes a social sign whose value is measured through reputation.

subchannels.name: Banner, Mark, and Trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: A visible mark identifies allegiance, location, condition, or a past contact event.
subchannels.active_motifs: banner or sign `ع ل م:B002/m01`; trace `ب ص ر:B004/m01`; scratch or defacement `ك د ح:B002/m01`; distinguishing facet `ش ف ق:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Meaning can be carried without speech through banners, surface traces, deliberate marks, and differentiating visual facets.

subchannels.name: Contrast, Exception, and Affirmation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Small grammatical operators redirect an utterance by contrast, exclusion, endpoint, or emphatic confirmation.
subchannels.active_motifs: contrast particle `ب ل ل:B008/m01`; affirmative reply `ب ل ي:B010/m01`; endpoint preposition `ء ل ي:B001/m01`; exception `غ ي ر:B005/m01`; exception from a set `خ ل و:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Lexical particles organize reasoning by setting boundaries, reversing expectations, and affirming what a prior statement leaves open.

subchannels.name: Number, Pronoun, and Collective Expression
subchannels.scene_or_process: Grammatical form shifts reference between singular, plural, accompaniment, and collected wording.
subchannels.active_motifs: plural or pronominal form `ء ل ي:B004/m01`; scattering into plurality `ب ل ي:B008/m01`; gathered wording `ق ر ء:B001/m02`; accompaniment `ء ل ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same lexical field that marks direction also regulates how participants and words are grouped in discourse.

subchannels.name: Method, Path, and Poetic Model
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker or worker follows an established formal pattern, method, or compositional route.
subchannels.active_motifs: poetic model `ق ر ء:B005/m01`; method or path `ق ر ء:B011/m01`; work method `ع م ل:B011/m01`; route or junction `ء ت ي:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Textual composition and practical action share the idea of moving through a recognized patterned course.

subchannels.name: Alarm, Clamor, and Bird Call
subchannels.scene_or_process: Non-discursive sound attracts attention through noise, alarm, or repeated animal vocalization.
subchannels.active_motifs: noise `و ع ي:B005/m01`; clamor `ب ل ل:B009/m01`; bird call `ب ل ل:B010/m01`; dove `ق م ر:B012/m01`; orator's projected voice `ش ق ق:B008/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Communication extends below propositional speech to attention-getting sound, resonant voice, and recognizable animal calls.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Meaning is announced, exchanged, inscribed, named, patterned, and carried through audible or visible signs.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; calling, recitation, denial, knowledge, and retained content appear at 84:11 and 84:21-23.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Formulaic greetings, banners, ink, grammar particles, poetic models, clamorous noise, and bird calls occupy the same transmission field.

parent_channels.name: Worship, Faith, and Ritual Submission

subchannels.name: Deity, Lordship, and Devotion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A human subject recognizes divine dominion and directs devotion toward the sovereign source.
subchannels.active_motifs: deity and worship `ء ل ه:B001/m01`; lordship and dominion `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; devoted reciter `ق ر ء:B001/m02`; faith `ء م ن:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Divine lordship supplies the relational center from which recitation, belief, and worship take their direction.

subchannels.name: Sanctuary and Consecrated Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: A bounded place is set apart for worship, prostration, and communal approach.
subchannels.active_motifs: sanctuary `س ج د:B002/m01`; place of prayer `ص ل ي:B008/m01`; sanctuary or sacred toponym `ص ل ح:B005/m01`; inhabited sacred place `ء ه ل:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Ritual action generates a spatial counterpart in the sanctuary as an inhabited and morally ordered place.

subchannels.name: Prostration, Bowing, and Bodily Submission
subchannels.scene_or_process: The body lowers itself in a visible act of worship and compliant posture.
subchannels.active_motifs: prostration `س ج د:B001/m01`; bowing `س ج د:B004/m01`; prayer `ص ل ي:B001/m01`; submission `ك و ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The refused prostration on the surface is clarified by a cluster of lowering, prayer, and willing submission.

subchannels.name: Supplication, Blessing, and Intercession
subchannels.scene_or_process: A worshipper calls toward a higher authority and seeks blessing, mediation, or a favorable response.
subchannels.active_motifs: invocation `د ع و:B001/m01`; blessing and intercession `ص ل ي:B002/m01`; liturgical affirmation `ء م ن:B003/m01`; divine invocation `ء ل ه:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The act of calling can move from a cry of ruin to prayerful invocation, blessing, and communal affirmation.

subchannels.name: Faith, Conviction, and Testimony
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inward conviction is publicly or verbally ratified as reliable testimony.
subchannels.active_motifs: faith `ء م ن:B002/m01`; testimony and affirmation `ء م ن:B003/m01`; established truth `ح ق ق:B005/m01`; insight `ب ص ر:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Belief is presented as both inward recognition and an assent grounded in perceived and established truth.

subchannels.name: Disbelief, Denial, and Rejection
subchannels.scene_or_process: A hearer covers over or rejects a received truth and attributes falsehood to it.
subchannels.active_motifs: disbelief `ك ف ر:B003/m01`; false denial `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`; attribution of falsehood `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; turning away `ظ ه ر:B022/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Denial combines cognitive rejection, false attribution, and bodily or social withdrawal from the message.

subchannels.name: Expiation, Disavowal, and Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A burdened subject is cleared through expiation, formal disavowal, or release from restraint.
subchannels.active_motifs: expiation `ك ف ر:B009/m01`; disavowal `ك ف ر:B005/m01`; absolution `خ ل و:B006/m01`; release `م ن ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Covering can function not only as denial but as a compensatory act that removes liability and restores freedom.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A worshipper recognizes sovereignty, adopts belief, performs embodied submission, invokes aid, and negotiates rejection or release.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; lordship, prostration, belief, disbelief, recitation, and recompense structure 84:6, 84:15, and 84:20-25.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sanctuary space, intercession, liturgical affirmation, expiation, and manumission-like release elaborate the ritual field.

parent_channels.name: Law, Authority, and Institutional Status

subchannels.name: Duty, Decree, and Binding Obligation
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authoritative determination imposes a duty that becomes due and must be fulfilled.
subchannels.active_motifs: binding duty `ح ق ق:B002/m01`; decree `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; obligatory exhortation `ك ذ ب:B003/m01`; formal reckoning `ح س ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The surah's language of due fulfillment and written records expands into a complete scene of authoritative obligation and accounting.

subchannels.name: Right, Claim, and Adversarial Dispute
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claimant asserts entitlement, another party contests it, and the dispute requires adjudication.
subchannels.active_motifs: legal right `ح ق ق:B003/m01`; dispute `ح ق ق:B004/m01`; claim and asserted lineage `د ع و:B002/m01`; argumentative dialogue `ح و ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Truth becomes institutional when it is framed as an enforceable right advanced and contested through claims.

subchannels.name: Permission, Access, and Licensed Action
subchannels.scene_or_process: An authority hears a request, grants entry or action, and opens an otherwise restricted avenue.
subchannels.active_motifs: permission `ء ذ ن:B004/m01`; hearing and acceptance `ء ذ ن:B002/m01`; release into access `خ ل و:B008/m01`; available avenue `ء ت ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The direct obedience of sky and earth to authorization supports a latent procedural scene of accepted request and opened access.

subchannels.name: Surety, Adequacy, and Guaranteed Performance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A guarantor or sufficient reserve secures performance when an outcome cannot rest on trust alone.
subchannels.active_motifs: adequacy and surety `ح س ب:B003/m01`; guarantor `ك و ن:B003/m01`; attribution of reliability or unreliability `ك ف ر:B006/m01`; protected charge `ح ق ق:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Reckoning includes the institutional question of whether a person, reserve, or guarantee is sufficient to cover an obligation.

subchannels.name: Liability, Absolution, and Formal Discharge
subchannels.scene_or_process: Responsibility is assigned, denied, or removed through a recognized act of discharge.
subchannels.active_motifs: disavowal `ك ف ر:B005/m01`; freedom from blame `خ ل و:B005/m01`; absolution `خ ل و:B006/m01`; removal of shame or liability `ظ ه ر:B013/m01`; release `م ن ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Institutional status changes when liability is explicitly severed and the subject emerges cleared of blame.

subchannels.name: Administration, Audit, and Official Office
subchannels.scene_or_process: An office gathers records, examines conduct, and renders an account under delegated authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: administration `ح س ب:B006/m01`; inquiry and testing `ح س ب:B010/m01`; official office `ع م ل:B003/m01`; discovery through inspection `ظ ه ر:B008/m01`

parent_channels.name: Community, Belonging, and Hospitality

parent_channels.name: Food, Drink, and Material Richness

subchannels.name: Sweet Water and Mixed Drink

parent_channels.name: Change, Trial, and Outcome

subchannels.name: Vicissitude, Fortune, and Uncertain Event

subchannels.name: Ruin, Collapse, and Overwhelming Calamity

subchannels.name: Return, Decline, and Reversed Course
subchannels.scene_or_process: A movement reaches a turning point and proceeds back toward an earlier place or diminished condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: return or decline `ح و ر:B005/m01`; return and outcome `ق ل ب:B005/m01`; elapsed condition `خ ل و:B003/m01`; reversing turn `ق ل ب:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The denied return in 84:14 is lexically linked to reversal, outcome, and decline after a completed interval.

subchannels.name: Repair, Substitution, and Restored Condition
subchannels.scene_or_process: A damaged or unsuitable element is repaired or replaced so the whole can function again.
subchannels.active_motifs: repair `ص ل ح:B001/m01`; provision and repair `غ ي ر:B001/m01`; substitution `غ ي ر:B003/m01`; nurture and repair `ر ب ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Change becomes restorative when alteration replaces a failed part or returns it to a sound condition.

subchannels.name: Delay, Detention, and Deferred Approach

subchannels.name: Termination, Death, and Burial

subchannels.name: Forgetting, Discarding, and Leaving Behind

subchannels.name: Wear, Decay, and Material Deterioration

subchannels.active_motifs: wear and decay `ب ل ي:B001/m01`; decline `ح و ر:B005/m01`; husk or exhausted covering `ك ف ر:B010/m01`; defacement `ك د ح:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Passage through successive states includes a material trajectory from intact form to worn and emptied residue.

subchannels.name: Persistence, Strength, and Survival
subchannels.scene_or_process: A subject continues through adversity by maintaining force and resisting collapse.
subchannels.active_motifs: persistence `ث ب ر:B004/m01`; strength `م ن ن:B002/m01`; functional soundness `ص ل ح:B003/m01`; power `ي م ن:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Against ruin and decay stands a counterprocess of sustained force, fitness, and survival.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Subjects pass through testing, reversal, delay, deterioration, repair, ruin, persistence, and final termination.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; the surah repeatedly stages irreversible transition, return, encounter, reckoning, and contrasting outcomes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Vicissitudes, calamity, structural repair, delayed approach, burial, forgetting, weathering, and stubborn persistence elaborate the passage from state to state.

parent_channels.name: Emotion, Value, and Social Standing

subchannels.scene_or_process: Favorable news or achievement produces visible gladness and a sense of welfare.

subchannels.name: Honor, Nobility, Purity, and Inner Worth

subchannels.active_motifs: honor `ح س ب:B004/m01`; nobility `ع ذ ب:B008/m01`; inner essence `س ر ر:B005/m01`; core essence `ق ل ب:B002/m01`; worthiness `ء ه ل:B003/m01`

subchannels.name: Shame, Blame, and Restored Standing

subchannels.name: Praise, Reputation, and Boasting

subchannels.active_motifs: reputation `س م و:B008/m01`; good reputation `ص ل ح:B004/m01`; boasting `ظ ه ر:B024/m01`; elevated standing `س م و:B002/m01`

subchannels.name: Concern, Caution, and Protective Care

subchannels.name: Indifference, Slackness, and Carefree Release
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person relaxes effort or concern, ranging from legitimate freedom from burden to negligent indifference.
subchannels.active_motifs: indifference `ب ل ي:B009/m01`; slackness `ء ل ي:B008/m01`; carefree state `خ ل و:B007/m01`; forgetting `ظ ه ر:B012/m01`

subchannels.name: Weakness, Strength, and Social Power

subchannels.name: Deception, Ridicule, and False Display

subchannels.name: Gratitude, Ingratitude, Favor, and Reproach

subchannels.synthesis: Value exchange becomes moral evaluation through the recipient's gratitude and the giver's restraint from humiliating reminder.

subchannels.name: Wealth, Scarcity, and Generous Capacity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material means range from scant reserve to surplus capable of supporting others.
subchannels.active_motifs: wealth `ي س ر:B003/m01`; little or scarcity `ي س ر:B002/m01`; surplus `ظ ه ر:B023/m01`; gift `ء ل ي:B012/m01`; scantness `ش ف ق:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Ease and generosity depend on a material threshold separating insufficiency from distributable surplus.

subchannels.name: Fitness, Worthiness, and Moral Eligibility

subchannels.active_motifs: worthiness `ء ه ل:B003/m01`; fitness `ص ل ح:B003/m01`; fitness for good `ء ر ض:B003/m01`; verified rightness `ح ق ق:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Evaluation reaches beyond beauty or status to the practical and moral question of eligibility.

subchannels.name: Excuse, Reproach, and Accountable Blame

subchannels.active_motifs: excuse `ب ل ي:B004/m01`; freedom from blame `خ ل و:B005/m01`; reproach `م ن ن:B003/m02`; reckoning `ح س ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Accountability is socially negotiated through explanation, judgment, and the possible removal or confirmation of blame.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Nobility, boasting, excuse, carefree indifference, deceptive display, scantness, benefaction, and reproach form a nuanced social-affective system.

parent_channels.name: Existence, Place, and Logical Relation

subchannels.name: Occurrence, Coming, and Event
subchannels.scene_or_process: A previously unrealized event comes into being and enters the experienced world.
subchannels.active_motifs: existence or occurrence `ك و ن:B001/m01`; coming event `ء ت ي:B001/m01`; vicissitude `د ع و:B006/m01`; encounter `ل ق ي:B004/m01`

subchannels.name: Place, Status, and Proximity
subchannels.scene_or_process: An entity occupies a location or rank defined relative to a nearby point.
subchannels.active_motifs: place or status `ك و ن:B002/m01`; proximity `ء ل ي:B002/m01`; likely place `ظ ن ن:B002/m01`; destination or outcome-place `ق ل ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Existential state is inseparable from relational position, whether spatially near or socially ranked.

subchannels.name: Emptiness, Absence, and No Caller

subchannels.active_motifs: emptiness `خ ل و:B001/m01`; no caller `د ع و:B008/m01`; uninhabited place `ء ه ل:B004/m01`; emptied contents `ل ق ي:B005/m01`

subchannels.name: Otherness, Exception, and Set Boundary

subchannels.active_motifs: otherness or exception `غ ي ر:B005/m01`; exception `خ ل و:B004/m01`; contrast particle `ب ل ل:B008/m01`; divided class `ط ب ق:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The closing exception for the faithful belongs to a broader logic of set membership and boundary marking.

subchannels.name: Phase, Condition, and Successive State
subchannels.scene_or_process: An entity occupies one condition, crosses a threshold, and enters another.
subchannels.active_motifs: state or phase `ط ب ق:B004/m01`; condition `ك و ن:B006/m01`; extended interval `م د د:B004/m01`; return or change `ح و ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Layer after layer is simultaneously spatial succession and passage through changing existential conditions.

subchannels.name: Necessity, Inevitability, and Constrained Outcome

subchannels.active_motifs: necessity `و ع ي:B006/m01`; obligatory exhortation `ك ذ ب:B003/m01`; binding duty `ح ق ق:B002/m01`; constraining enclosure `ط ب ق:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Fulfillment is framed not merely as prediction but as a constrained state in which obligation and outcome coincide.

subchannels.name: Limit, Endpoint, and Duration

subchannels.synthesis: Striving toward the Lord combines direction and duration within a process whose end is fixed.

subchannels.name: Affirmation, Contrast, and Established Reality

subchannels.synthesis: The surah's corrective particles and truth vocabulary jointly move discourse from denial or supposition to established reality.

subchannels.name: Interior, Middle, Surface, and Complete Boundary
subchannels.scene_or_process: An entity is mapped from inner core through middle region to outer surface as a bounded whole.
subchannels.active_motifs: outer-inner completeness `ب ش ر:B008/m01`; midst `ظ ه ر:B017/m01`; surface `ب ش ر:B001/m01`; inner essence `ق ل ب:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Spatial relation becomes mereological, defining a whole through coordinated interior, middle, and exterior zones.

subchannels.name: Behind, Outskirts, and Outer Route
subchannels.scene_or_process: A point is located beyond the central field, behind the observer, or along an exterior road.
subchannels.active_motifs: beyond or behind `و ر ي:B006/m01`; outskirts or outer road `ظ ه ر:B015/m01`; back `ظ ه ر:B002/m01`; remote place `ك ف ر:B012/m01`
